title: POV: Hong Kong's Tram Has Run Since 1904 — Ride It for ~30 Cents | China Travel Expert
description:
From the front of the top deck, a Hong Kong tram ride is one of the best-value seats in any city on Earth.

These double-decker trams have rattled along Hong Kong Island since 1904 — over 120 years. The whole fleet is double-decker, which earned it a Guinness World Record, and the fare is a flat HK$2.30 (about 30 US cents) no matter how far you ride. Locals call them the "ding ding" for the bell.

🧭 Expert Tip: climb to the upper deck and grab the very front row — it's a slow, open-window street-level tour of Hong Kong Island for pocket change.

香港叮叮车自1904年运行至今，全是双层电车（吉尼斯纪录），单一票价约港币2.3元、不论远近。上层最前排，是全城最超值的位置。
